# Prototemplate

> Prototemplate (https://prototemplate.vercel.app) is the General Translation knowledge base. It holds the brand book, the brand directives, the design lab with its directions and sites, the repository documents, the agent skills, and the mark explorations, and serves all of it as live pages in one viewer: a sidebar of thumbnails, a toolbar, a stage, and an index panel that lists every page on the site. General Translation (https://generaltranslation.com) is the localization platform for developers. The site is made by Kevin Liu.

The design lab holds seventeen directions for the General Translation website, each one built and running live with GSAP motion, WebGL shader heroes and a ruled-line design system. Every direction is a real page, not a mockup. Thirteen are single-page explorations; three are full site concepts (a home page plus an enterprise page) built on the shared Toolchain foundation; one is the site that shipped, rebuilt page for page.

## Routes

- [Gallery](https://prototemplate.vercel.app/): the design lab, the seventeen directions read as an article, one live exhibit at a time, or as a grid of captures, with the anatomy wall and the capabilities ledger.
- [Brand](https://prototemplate.vercel.app/brand): the brand book, the identity canon in ten sections.
- [Docs](https://prototemplate.vercel.app/docs): the repository documents read in the browser, one address per document at /docs/<slug>, with the build log under the readme.
- [Deck](https://prototemplate.vercel.app/deck): the General Translation brand deck, 52 slides in its own viewer.
- [Skills](https://prototemplate.vercel.app/skills): the agent skills that carry the brand and design rules into coding sessions.
- [Marks](https://prototemplate.vercel.app/marks): the mark explorations, every candidate drawn in one color.
- [Compare](https://prototemplate.vercel.app/compare): two directions side by side in scroll-synced frames.
- [Present](https://prototemplate.vercel.app/present): the presenter, a full-screen walkthrough of the redesign with every prototype live.
- [Archive](https://prototemplate.vercel.app/archive): the retired directions, each kept at /archive/<slug> as a full-page capture with the commit that last held its code.
- Each direction lives at https://prototemplate.vercel.app/d/<slug>; site concepts add /d/<slug>/enterprise.

## Documents

- [Readme](https://prototemplate.vercel.app/docs): what Prototemplate is, how to run it, where to read next, and the build log.
- [The brand](https://prototemplate.vercel.app/docs/brand): the identity canon: the name, the idea, the character and voice, the mark, color, type, language as material, and the Dossier as the completed reference.
- [The design system](https://prototemplate.vercel.app/docs/design): the four-color system, the line law, rails and seams, the doubled line, iso, the 1-bit language, moving type, motion discipline.
- [Architecture](https://prototemplate.vercel.app/docs/architecture): the code map: the direction registry, the toolchain single source of truth and fork rescoping, the componentized instruments, the mirror.
- [The ship loop](https://prototemplate.vercel.app/docs/ship-loop): the verify-and-ship procedure every round runs: the line audit, the practices ratchet, types, filming, the backup branch, the mirror build.
- [The libraries](https://prototemplate.vercel.app/docs/libraries): the index of the componentized instruments; the living version, with plates running, is the build log under the readme.

## Directions

- [Toolchain](https://prototemplate.vercel.app/d/toolchain): the minimalist evolution of the current site, one ruled column, bento rows whose shells never repeat, and isometric line-art diagrams.
- [Chroma Flow](https://prototemplate.vercel.app/d/chroma-flow): a curl-noise flow field pulls streaming color through the nameplate above one continuous product pipeline.
- [Dither Field](https://prototemplate.vercel.app/d/dither-field): hellos in eight scripts resolve out of Bayer noise and dissolve back, pixel by pixel.
- [Aurora Paper](https://prototemplate.vercel.app/d/aurora-paper): a grainy aurora drifts behind an otherwise disciplined paper page.
- [Glyph Rain](https://prototemplate.vercel.app/d/glyph-rain): a particle rain of world-script glyphs gathers into each word of the headline, holds, and re-scatters.
- [Prism Light](https://prototemplate.vercel.app/d/prism-light): one white beam splits through a glass prism and the translations ride the dispersion fan out.
- [Lens Gate](https://prototemplate.vercel.app/d/lens-gate): the ruled paper passes through one breathing glass; components enter in English and exit translated.
- [Paper Foundry](https://prototemplate.vercel.app/d/paper-foundry): the bento machined into paper, hairline cells set into a brushed-graphite sheet.
- [Terminus Board](https://prototemplate.vercel.app/d/terminus-board): a departure hall for locales, a split-flap headline over a flip-wave cell grid.
- [Wide Rule](https://prototemplate.vercel.app/d/wide-rule): one analytic interference band crosses enormous quiet space.
- [Event Horizon](https://prototemplate.vercel.app/d/event-horizon): component walls dive with curved perspective into a black-hole gate; English falls in, translations emerge.
- [Hourglass](https://prototemplate.vercel.app/d/hourglass): dark corridor walls of UI cards pinch at an hourglass waist holding the mark, the flags, and the calls to action.
- [Singularity](https://prototemplate.vercel.app/d/singularity): the enterprise gate, the lensing horizon alone on open paper, customers riding the locale belt.
- [Dossier](https://prototemplate.vercel.app/d/singularity-dossier): a full site whose home folds the every-stack argument into the hero terminal, with an enterprise page that reads as an evidence file.
- [Orbit](https://prototemplate.vercel.app/d/singularity-orbit): a full site with a one-line terminal hero and the system pieces the dossier retired.
- [Signal](https://prototemplate.vercel.app/d/singularity-signal): a full site with the terminal split into session and output panes and an enterprise page as the broadcast.
- [Shipped](https://prototemplate.vercel.app/d/production): what the directions produced, the site now live at generaltranslation.com, rebuilt here page for page.

## Archive

Eleven earlier versions were retired and their routes deleted. Each stays viewable as a full-page capture at /archive/<slug>: archive-press (Wide Field), bento-foundry, blueprint-atlas, concrete-mono, concrete-origin, concrete-source, field-magnet, flipboard-terminus, kinetic-verba, typographic-broadcast, and white-gallery.

## About

- Built with Next.js, GSAP, and hand-written WebGL and canvas field libraries (horizon-field, glyph-field, prismatic-field).
- Made by Kevin Liu for General Translation.
- General Translation: https://generaltranslation.com
